result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. I made the change in one place: the region query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (`listOpenSupportTicketsInRegion`, around line 10023). It now uses the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.opened_date, t.id` as the sales-rep list. The closed-ticket and region filters are unchanged.

`RegionManagerTest`, `RegionReportTest` and `DashboardTest` pass offline with no failures. None of the existing tests assert the ticket order, so I did not add a test for the example in the task. Nothing is committed.
